statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope unexplained by standard evaluation
The syncope and near-syncope occur in the setting of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The diagnosis codes are R55 and I34.0
The service was denied under reason code CO-22
The denial reason is that coverage may be available through another insurer pursuant to coordination of benefits protocols

Long-term continuous ECG monitoring is indicated for comprehensive rhythm analysis to determine if transient loss-of-consciousness events are driven by intermittent arrhythmias associated with the valvular pathology
